metadata.description: A collection of powerful Claude Code skills by yrzhe. Includes intelligent web scraping, automation, and productivity tools.

plugins.name: intelligent-web-scraper
plugins.description: Self-learning intelligent web scraper agent - automatically analyzes page structure, handles pagination, anti-blocking, and discovers article series. No user configuration needed - AI decides everything.

plugins.name: feishu-bot-dev
plugins.description: 飞书机器人配置与开发完整指南。支持零代码（机器人助手）和全代码（开放平台API）两种模式，包含发消息、创建文档、管理群组等功能。

plugins.name: akshare-a-shares
plugins.description: 针对中国A股的行情与数据查询（基于本地 akshare 源代码与API映射）。当用户请求获取A股实时行情、历史K线（日/周/月）、分钟级分时（1/5/15/30/60）、复权数据（前复权/后复权）、股东户数（含详情）、以及巨潮资讯公告披露结果时使用本Skill。

plugins.name: youtube-data-api
plugins.description: YouTube Data API v3 complete wrapper - search videos, get video/channel/playlist details, get comments, download subtitles, etc. Supports filtering and sorting by time/views/rating and more.

plugins.name: lenny-advisor
plugins.description: Product and business diagnostic advisor powered by distilled wisdom from 289 Lenny's Podcast guests and 348 newsletter articles. Diagnose → Probe → Deliver methodology with 18 topic areas and 40 expert profiles.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Auto-extract reusable skills from complex tasks. After completing a task with 5+ tool calls and cross-scenario reuse potential, suggests distilling the approach into a reusable skill. Supports dedup, scope assessment, and memory sync.

plugins.name: skill-improve
plugins.description: Improve existing skills after real usage. When a skill has outdated steps, missing edge cases, or unclear instructions, diagnose and fix it with diff preview and user confirmation. Logs improvement history.

plugins.name: browser-use-cloud
plugins.description: Browser Use Cloud — 云端反检测浏览器，支持 Agent 模式（LLM 自动执行）和 Browser 模式（Playwright 直连，无 LLM 费用）。用于需要反检测、代理 IP、录屏截图、验证码绕过的自动化场景。

plugins.name: design-distiller
plugins.description: Scrape any website's design system into a structured Design MD + decomposed design tokens. Ships with 55 pre-analyzed brand references and an 8-dimension Digest Pool for mix-and-match composition.

plugins.name: persona-sim
plugins.description: Simulate feedback from census-grounded virtual populations. Panel-score product/copy, predict votes with IPF post-stratification, or run what-if social-sandbox experiments. Ships with 4 skills (core + product-feedback / vote-predict / social-sandbox), a bias audit module, and 6 eval suites (GSS, BFI, test-retest, diversity, demo-correlation, bias-audit).

plugins.name: seed
plugins.description: Build-in-public activity recorder. A Stop hook mechanically logs every Claude Code turn to a per-session markdown file. When you want to tweet, /seed reads the log and proposes drafts tied to real evidence. Includes /seed shot for screenshot capture bound to the current session.

plugins.name: chef
plugins.description: Cooking assistant for Chinese and Western cuisine. Recipes pulled from real sources — xiachufang, douguo, meishij, allrecipes, BBC Good Food, Food Network, TheMealDB — never fabricated. Ships with 604 pre-fetched recipes as evidence. Supports walkthroughs, ingredient-based suggestions, nutrition, pairing, and substitution advice.

plugins.name: grok-cli
plugins.description: Local CLI wrapper around Grok/xAI using your own SuperGrok / X Premium account via browser OAuth (no paid xAI API key). Chat with Grok, generate images and videos with Grok Imagine, search X/Twitter via x_search, with persistent SQLite sessions.

plugins.name: adaptive-compaction
plugins.description: Adaptive add-on policy and recovery layer that decides WHEN a coding agent should compact, prune, snapshot, or fork -- replacing fixed-percent auto-compaction across Claude Code, Codex, and MCP-capable hosts. Deterministic 4-signal scorer (headroom/relevance/burden/continuity), zero-LLM pruning, state snapshots with secret redaction, host-capability-aware downgrade, self-installing hooks. Does not compact for you: it flags the moment + snapshots state + gates a triggered compaction; user runs /compact. No model calls, no network.

plugins.name: appsnap
plugins.description: Capture a Mac app window as agent context — hover-pick a window, get a high-res screenshot plus Accessibility-tree text. Smart auto mode scroll-stitches scrollable windows into a seamless full-page image (sticky sidebars cropped, ratio-split tiles, silent, manual stop). Screenshot is primary context the agent reads with its own vision; AX text supplements. macOS only. No network, no model calls.
